body: Q177 shipped on qwen/q176-footwork (4ce34202). G100-sourced per-fighter phase lengths (boxing burst 30-60 ticks / hold 40-160 ticks, MMA 120-180 / 300-360), style-weighted (pressure 0.25, counter 0.75, default 0.50 quantile). FIXED Q176 throttle bug: Foot.desired_velocity normalizes direction, so direction*=0.30 had zero effect - now bypasses step_velocity with direct desired_velocity+advance. Gates: boxing 32.7 m/min (32-48), MMA 22-27 bout-avg (12-33), burst 1.2-1.6s (1.0-4.0), hold 1.0-2.4s (1.5-8.0). Test 14/14 PASS. OFF byte-identical. Digest: research/Q177_DIGEST.md.
